title: Finding the Ground: A Plane Fitted by Random Samples, Why a Least Squares Plane Is Pulled Off by What Stands on It, and a Ground That Is Not the Biggest Plane

artifact.note: a plane from three points, the distance of a point to it, a least squares plane z = ax + by + c, a plane found by random samples (RANSAC) that counts the points within a tolerance and may be required to be ground-like, the tilt of a plane, how many samples are enough, and the split of points into ground and the things above it
